content: GMCP constraints for boop: Mudlet can send GMCP support/request messages with sendGMCP, but most game modules update from server events. IRE/Nexus documents Char.Items as inventory/room item data with live updates, Char.Skills as known-skill data, Room.Info as the current room object with num, area, exits, and other metadata, Char.Vitals as character vitals/charstats, and IRE.Target.Set/Info as current target id and target information including hpperc. boop should therefore treat GMCP event order as asynchronous and keep room, item, target, skills, rage, and vitals state idempotent.
